review_candidates.title: Work in Portugal
review_candidates.description: Lavora in Portogallo Ti piacerebbe iniziare a esplorare il mondo? Sei alla ricerca della tua prima esperienza lavorativa? Desideri cambiare carriera, dare una svolta alla tua vita o semplicemente trasferirti all'estero? Ti offriamo uno splendido alloggio a Lisbona a prezzi super convenienti (grazie a un fantastico sconto aziendale riservato come benefit), un ambiente di lavoro internazionale e un ufficio pazzesco a due passi dalla spiaggia a Lisbona! Stiamo selezionando professionisti italiani dinamici per unirsi a team globali nel cuore del Portogallo. Questa è l'opportunità perfetta per chi cerca un cambiamento radicale o vuole iniziare il proprio percorso professionale in un ambiente stimolante e multiculturale. Il meglio di tutto questo? Decidi tu! Lavora al 100% da remoto da qualsiasi parte del Portogallo continentale, oppure vieni a trovarci nei nostri moderni uffici a Lisbona... inclusi i nostri incredibili uffici sulla spiaggia (beach offices) ! Cosa ti offriamo? (Pacchetto di Benvenuto e Alloggio) : Ti supportiamo fin dal primo giorno! Alloggio iniziale : 2 settimane di hotel gratuite al tuo arrivo per permetterti di ambientarti senza stress. Alloggio aziendale scontato : Un benefit speciale! Ti offriamo una sistemazione a Lisbona a un prezzo super accessibile, gestita direttamente dall'azienda per azzerare le spese eccessive del mercato immobiliare. Supporto amministrativo : Gestiamo noi tutta la burocrazia, i documenti locali (NIF/NISS) e la contrattualistica. Stipendio competitivo : Retribuzione attrattiva e fortemente competitiva sul mercato portoghese. Chi stiamo cercando? (Requisiti) : Lingua: Italiano a livello madrelingua o fluente (C1/C2). Inglese: Livello minimo B2 (necessario per la formazione e la comunicazione interna). Competenze: Eccellenti doti comunicative, orientamento al cliente e forte flessibilità. Mindset: Spirito di squadra, curiosità verso il mondo e tanta motivazione a vivere un'esperienza multiculturale sotto il sole! Pronto/a a metterti in gioco? Candidati ora inviando il tuo CV in inglese e prepara le valigie! Welcome to Portugal!

review_candidates.title: Video Editor
review_candidates.description: About 1M1B 1M1B (One Million for One Billion) is a United Nations–accredited non-profit that has spent the last decade mobilising and skilling young people to create large-scale social and environmental impact. Our programmes run across 5,000+ schools and colleges, with 25,000+ teachers trained and 800,000+ youth skilled. We are building India's future-ready AI and Green Skills talent, with a strong focus on tier-3 towns and rural India. Globally, we work to turn India's youth dividend into a climate dividend and an AI dividend, creating opportunities for young Indians to present at national platforms and United Nations forums as climate innovators, AI talent and sustainability leaders. About the role We are looking for a hands-on, full-time Video Editor who thrives on fast-paced edits and sharp cuts. You will turn raw footage from our programmes, events and field visits into scroll-stopping content for Instagram and YouTube, from punchy Reels and trend-driven highlights to long-form videos and documentaries. Working closely with the communications, programme and partnerships teams, you will shape how the world sees and hears the 1M1B story, with a strong emphasis on rhythm, sound design and modern editing techniques. Key responsibilities Editing and post-production Edit fast-paced, high-energy content with tight cuts, strong pacing and a clear narrative hook Own the full post-production workflow, from rough cut to final delivery Colour correct and grade footage for a consistent, polished and modern look Design and mix sound, including music selection, sound effects, transitions, dialogue clean-up and audio levelling Social media and platform content Create Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and trend-driven highlight videos optimised for engagement Edit long-form YouTube videos, event films and short documentaries on our programmes and impact stories Adapt content across formats and aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) for Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and other platforms Stay on top of social media trends, editing styles, audio trends and platform best practices Storytelling Collaborate with the communications team on scripting, storyboarding and creative direction Turn programme footage, interviews and field shoots into compelling stories of youth, climate and AI impact Production support Turn around event highlights, launch videos and campaign assets on tight timelines Add motion graphics, text animations, subtitles and captions where required Collaboration Work with cross-functional teams to understand briefs and deliver on time Incorporate feedback efficiently and manage multiple projects simultaneously Qualifications Bachelor's degre 2–4 years of professional video editing experience, ideally for social media and digital platforms Experience in a non-profit, social impact, media or content-driven environment is an advantage Skills Strong command of Adobe Premiere Pro and/or Final Cut Pro. DaVinci Resolve is a strong plus Colour correction and grading skills, with a good eye for modern visual styles Strong sound design and audio editing skills, with a sense of rhythm, timing and beat-synced cutting Working knowledge of After Effects or similar tools for motion graphics, titles and transitions Proven experience editing Reels, Shorts and YouTube content, with an understanding of hooks, retention and pacing Ability to edit both short-form and long-form, including documentary-style storytelling Familiarity with CapCut or similar mobile-first editing tools is a plus Attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment Interest in youth, education and sustainability How to apply Send your CV along with a showreel or portfolio of recent work (links to Instagram, YouTube or Drive are welcome) to hr@onemoneb.org.

review_candidates.title: Tunnels Lead
review_candidates.description: Job Description WSP is seeking an experienced and highly accomplished Tunnels Lead to join our Middle East Transport & Infrastructure team, based in the UAE and supporting projects across the GCC and wider Middle East region. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving excellence in tunnel engineering, overseeing the delivery of complex underground infrastructure projects, and leading the growth and development of a specialist design discipline. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise in tunnel and underground structures design with strong project delivery and people leadership capabilities. They will play a key role in winning and delivering major transportation, rail, metro, highway, utility, and underground infrastructure projects while mentoring multidisciplinary engineering teams and supporting the continued expansion of WSP's tunnelling capabilities throughout the region. Responsibilities Technical Leadership Serve as the regional technical authority for tunnelling and underground infrastructure projects. Lead the design and review of TBM tunnels, IMT tunnels, tunnel shafts, underground stations, cut-and-cover structures, retaining systems, and associated underground works. Provide expert technical guidance throughout all project phases, from feasibility studies and concept design through detailed design and construction support. Ensure designs comply with international standards, local regulations, client requirements, and industry best practices. Drive innovation, value engineering, and risk management across all tunnel engineering activities. Engage with WSP’s global tunnels community to drive technical excellence through knowledge share, future ready, and global WSP initiatives. Project Delivery Lead and oversee the successful delivery of complex tunnel and underground infrastructure projects across the Middle East. Manage project technical scope, programme, quality, resource allocation, and commercial performance. Coordinate multidisciplinary teams including geotechnical, civil, structural, rail, highways, utilities, and construction specialists. Ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Support construction supervision teams by providing specialist design advice and resolving complex engineering challenges. Discipline Leadership Develop and drive WSP’s tunnels growth strategy across the Middle East region. Lead, develop, and grow WSP's Tunnelling discipline within the Middle East. Manage and mentor tunnel engineers and technical specialists across multiple offices. Support recruitment, succession planning, performance development, and technical capability building. Establish and maintain technical excellence frameworks, design processes, and best practices across the discipline. Foster a collaborative and high-performing team culture. Business Development Support regional business growth and strategic planning initiatives. Engage with clients, contractors, government entities, and key stakeholders across the region. Participate in business development activities, client presentations, technical workshops, and industry forums. Lead technical inputs for bids, proposals, and major project pursuits. Identify emerging market opportunities and contribute to the expansion of WSP's tunnelling portfolio. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related discipline. Master's Degree in Tunnel Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a relevant field would be advantageous. Minimum 15+ years of professional experience in tunnel and underground infrastructure engineering. Proven experience leading the design and delivery of major tunnelling projects, preferably within rail, metro, highway, utility, or underground infrastructure sectors. Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams and large-scale project delivery. Experience working on international projects within the Middle East, Europe, Asia, Australia, or North America is highly desirable. Strong understanding of both conventional and mechanized tunnelling methodologies. Experience in: TBM (Tunnel Boring Machine) tunnels. NATM / SEM tunnelling methods. Cut-and-cover tunnel design. Underground station and shaft design. Geotechnical and structural analysis for underground works. Ground-structure interaction. Temporary works and construction methodologies. Tunnel safety, fire life safety, and risk management. Design software and analytical tools relevant to tunnel engineering and underground structures. Proven ability to lead high-performing technical teams. Strong project management and commercial awareness. Excellent client management and stakeholder engagement skills. Demonstrated ability to secure and deliver major engineering commissions. Strong communication, presentation, and report-writing capabilities. Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world. With us, you can. Apply today.

review_candidates.title: Treatment Plant Estimator - Critical Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: Based in St. Louis, Core & Main is a leader in advancing reliable infrastructure™ with local service, nationwide®. As a specialty distributor with a focus on water, wastewater, storm drainage and fire protection products and related services, Core & Main provides solutions to municipalities, private water companies and professional contractors across municipal, non-residential and residential end markets, nationwide. With over 370 locations across the U.S., the company provides its customers local expertise backed by a national supply chain. Core & Main’s 5,700 associates are committed to helping their communities thrive with safe and reliable infrastructure. Visit coreandmain.com to learn more. Job Summary Responsible for developing strategic pricing objectives and imperatives that support the resilience and robustness of critical infrastructure sectors, including energy, transportation, water, and telecommunications. Provides analytical and strategic pricing expertise with a focus on regulatory compliance, security standards, and risk mitigation unique to critical infrastructure projects. Reviews requests for quotations to assist the proposal team in developing estimates and pricing strategies that prioritize continuity, reliability, and public safety. Gathers data in order to determine effectiveness and profitability of pricing strategies and tactics within the context of government mandates, industry best practices, and evolving threat landscapes. Follows economic market and competitor pricing strategies, with a special emphasis on those affecting infrastructure assets, and provides tactical and strategic solutions that safeguard essential services. Identifies opportunities for improving pricing and profitability of existing accounts by considering factors such as infrastructure interdependencies, lifecycle management, and emergency preparedness. Major Tasks, Responsibilities And Key Accountabilities Researches plans and specifications to identify requirements, codes, and standards specific to critical infrastructure systems, including cybersecurity, physical security, and resilience measures. Evaluates material and construction requirements with respect to their impact on infrastructure reliability and compliance with local, state, and federal regulations governing essential services. Determines if company supplied material meet local/state/federal specifications. Determines accurate and detailed quantities of products and related specialty materials as measured from construction plan sets. Accurately identifies the type of material necessary for construction of facilities. Communicates with material vendor and accurately determines availability and delivery times for specialty products. Communicates with design engineer or owner to clarify any unusual or special material issues via phone, e- mail or written Requests for Information (RFI). Meets with owners/engineers/architects to assist with or suggest specific design/build concepts. Meets with local engineering design teams to recommend value engineering options for bid projects. Actively works with sales team to design successful bid strategies. Assists in bid preparation and ensures customers receive quotations in a timely manner. Tracks and monitors competitor pricing to determine market value of bids. Coordinates and reviews work of other estimators or sales staff as a senior employee. Conducts continuing education training and mentoring of other sales and estimating staff on a regular basis. Preferred Qualifications 5 years prior experience specific to bid preparation, sales, or construction. Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering, Construction Management or related discipline. Typically requires BS/BA in a related discipline. Generally, 5-8 years of experience in a related field; certification is required in some areas OR MS/MA and generally 3-5 years of experience in a related field. Certification is required in some areas. This information indicates the general nature and level of work performed by associates in this role. It is not designed to contain a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of associates assigned to this role. This description supersedes any previous or undated descriptions for this role. Management retains the right to add or change the duties of the position at any time. review_candidates.title: Technical Team Leader – Mechanical Commissioning (CxA)- Datacenter
review_candidates.description: FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full-service integrated technology consultancy and professional services to the built environment. We partner with clients to improve asset performance, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios. Job Description We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to lead the commissioning delivery team of hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects. The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0–L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST). This position is site-centric and requires hands-on leadership through Integrated Systems Testing, including failure mode and fault tolerance validation, ensuring systems meet design intent, availability objectives and operational readiness requirements in line with Uptime Institute, IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards. Key Responsibilities Mechanical Commissioning Leadership Spearhead end-to-end commissioning of mission-critical electrical systems including MV/LV utility and distribution systems, transformers, protection systems, switchgear, busway systems, UPS (static and rotary), battery systems, standby generators, paralleling gear, load bank systems, STS, PDUs, RPPs, and critical power distribution. Integrated Systems Testing & Validation Architect and execute IST strategies and scripts aligned with Uptime Institute methodology. Lead failure mode testing, redundancy validation, and fault tolerance demonstrations across black-building, partial load, and full load testing scenarios. Oversee Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) for major electrical equipment. Direct Functional Performance Testing (FPT) to verify system operation under normal, abnormal and failure conditions. Design Assurance & Technical Review Conduct design and peer reviews at all project stages from a commissionability and operational resilience perspective. Evaluate electrical schematics, single line diagrams, protection philosophies and vendor technical submittals to identify and mitigate commissionability risks. Systems Integration & Controls Validation Validate integration of electrical systems with EPMS and BMS platforms, verifying alarms, trending, sequencing, interlocks, and operational visibility during IST. Coordinate with mechanical and IT commissioning teams to ensure holistic system integration and performance. Project Coordination & Stakeholder Management Collaborate with project managers, construction teams, MEP contractors, OEMs, and client representatives to ensure seamless commissioning delivery. Facilitate resolution of technical issues and coordinate across disciplines to maintain programme momentum. Documentation, Compliance & Handover Develop and manage commissioning plans, execution strategies, test scripts, procedures, checklists, issue logs, punch lists, risk registers, and final commissioning reports. Ensure strict compliance with Uptime Institute Tier Standards, IEC, IEEE, NFPA, NEC and applicable local codes. Support client handover and transition to operations with comprehensive systems documentation. Risk Management & Issue Resolution Identify, analyse and resolve electrical system deficiencies during commissioning to mitigate risk to programme, safety and availability objectives. Health, Safety & Team Leadership Enforce site HSE compliance including RAMS reviews, toolbox talks and risk assessments. Lead, mentor and develop commissioning engineers, subcontractors and vendors to deliver excellence. Requirements 15+ years overall mechanical engineering, testing and commissioning experience. 8+ years data-center or mission-critical mechanical commissioning experience. Proven leadership of at least 2 complete L2 to L5 commissioning cycles. Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs of hyperscale datacenter projects. Experience managing 15–20+ Cx engineers. Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, chilled-water systems, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, BMS/controls, fuel systems, fire protection and utilities. Experience with high-density/liquid cooling is highly desirable. Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA and applicable local codes/standards. Strong knowledge of Sequence of Operations, controls integration, TAB, hydronic balancing and failure-mode testing. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills. Qualifications Preferred Certifications CxA/CBCP | CDCP/CDCS | Uptime Institute ATD | ASHRAE-related credentials Ideal Background Hyperscale/colocation data centers, mission-critical facilities, semiconductor, pharmaceutical/biopharma, advanced manufacturing or other high-availability facilities. Additional Information At FPC, we’re not just a company—we’re a thriving community where innovation flourishes, ideas are celebrated, and careers are shaped. When you join us, you become part of a dynamic team that: Shapes the Future: Work on groundbreaking projects that are redefining industries with sustainability, cutting-edge technology, and bold ambition. Supports Your Growth: From leadership training to cross-functional collaboration, we prioritize your professional development and empower you to explore new ideas, take initiative, and grow in your career. Values Balance and Inclusion: We celebrate diversity, foster collaboration, and ensure every voice is heard—while maintaining a strong commitment to work-life balance. Creates Impact: Contribute to the delivery of iconic, high-performance buildings and innovative solutions that have a lasting, positive impact on the world.
